answer: Because the tundra burn is recorded at the pigment settlement, the bridge audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 57% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 313 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
